implementation.summary: MeasureCard floated at TopStart in the frame-sized Box behind one named private val MeasureCardWidth = 228.dp, following the ErrorCardWidth/BannerTopInset precedent. The organism gained the additive footer: String? = null parameter rendering ink3 text inside the card's own border below the finding block - source-compatible, zero existing callers. Its KDoc no longer claims the card is a sidebar panel that is not an overlay. The @Preview's Top value was corrected from 9dp to 15dp, which is what the design's own algorithm produces over its real ELS fixture. Ten localisation keys added with English values, and light and dark previews of a measuring frozen stage.

troubleshooting.issue: No Compose UI-test harness exists in this repo and this host cannot load Skiko, so no composable in either task can be asserted automatically.
troubleshooting.resolution: The gating decision was extracted into pure internal functions (shouldMeasure, measureTarget, measureDispatch) in core/measure/MeasureGate.kt and unit-tested with 14 cases, converting the testable part of the interaction into commonTest coverage. Everything genuinely visual is recorded blocked in execution/MANUAL-CHECKS.md with runnable instructions.

troubleshooting.issue: Beyond the task's scope: T-10 gave the indicator DOT a Dumping branch but the label beside it still read FROZEN, so the status line contradicted its own indicator for the whole ~2.7s dump - the defect AC-72 exists to prevent.
troubleshooting.resolution: MirrorContent now resolves a Dumping label above the frozen case, in the same order indicatorDot puts it. Found while wiring the card rather than by a test; the same class of defect as the error-handling spec's T-32.

troubleshooting.issue: MeasureCard's shipped @Preview carried Top = 9dp, a value the design's own algorithm cannot produce from its fixture (the nearest node above item_price is divider_1, bottom edge 183, giving 198-183=15).
troubleshooting.resolution: Corrected to 15dp with a comment pointing at the gate record. Four of the preview's five values and its finding string already reproduced exactly, so it was the right node with one hand-typed figure. Verified twice independently.
